item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will improve with slightly cooler morning over Guangdong today. With the monsoon moderating gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week, temperatures will rise over the coastal areas. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. It will be cloudier over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring showers to southern China midweek next week.
